rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The draft resolution moved by the Chief Whip of the Majority Party on 23 September 2008 notes that the President of the Republic submitted his resignation to the Speaker of the National Assembly on 21 September 2008, and that 'the letter by the President' makes it effective when Parliament has finalised the matter. The letter read to the House on 22 September 2008 is signed 'Thabo Mbeki', and in the debate on the resolution Dr C P Mulder and Mr S N Swart name Mr Mbeki.

locator.heading: RESIGNATION OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC (Draft Resolution)

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The House agreed on division to the Chief Whip's motion, paragraph (3) of which 'agrees that the resignation of the President of the Republic of South Africa will take effect on 25 September 2008'; paragraph (4) thanks him for his service as Deputy President and President. The printed division is Ayes 298, Noes 10, Abstain 1; later that day the Chair announced that the result first reported (299 in favour, 10 against) had omitted the recorded abstention. In the debate Mr S N Swart refers to 'President Thabo Mbeki' and says 'this resignation is to take effect on Thursday, 25 September'.

locator.heading: RESIGNATION OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC (Draft Resolution)

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Speaker read a letter from Chief Justice Pius Langa: he had been advised of the resignation of the President of the Republic and that 'it will take effect on 25 September 2008', and under section 86(3) he determined that the National Assembly would meet to fill the vacancy on Thursday 25 September 2008 at 11 o'clock.
